title: Microsoft 365 Security Assessment | Pro Link Systems
summary: A one-time, read-only review of about 80 Microsoft 365 security controls, with a findings report sorted by severity and a complimentary review call.
caption:
You can now order a Microsoft 365 Security Assessment from Pro Link Systems online.

What it covers: about 80 security controls, including identity and MFA, Conditional Access, admin access, email security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), SharePoint and OneDrive sharing, Teams, Defender, Intune, Purview and audit logging.

What you get: a findings report sorted by severity, reviewed by our team before release, and a complimentary review call.

How it works: order online, your Global Administrator approves read-only access in about five minutes, and we take it from there. We never change a setting. $2,500 one-time.
